def sumLexLift {α₁ : Type u_1} {α₂ : Type u_2} {β₁ : Type u_3} {β₂ : Type u_4} {γ₁ : Type u_5} {γ₂ : Type u_6}
  (f₁ : α₁ → β₁ → Finset γ₁) (f₂ : α₂ → β₂ → Finset γ₂) (g₁ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₁) (g₂ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₂)
  (a : α₁ ⊕ α₂) (b : β₁ ⊕ β₂) : Finset (γ₁ ⊕ γ₂) :=
  match a, b with
  | Sum.inl a₁, Sum.inl b₁ => (f₁ a₁ b₁).image Sum.inl
  | Sum.inl a₁, Sum.inr b₂ => (g₁ a₁ b₂).image Sum.inl ∪ (g₂ a₁ b₂).image Sum.inr
  | Sum.inr a₂, Sum.inl b₁ => ∅
  | Sum.inr a₂, Sum.inr b₂ => (f₂ a₂ b₂).image Sum.inr
